summary: Stellantis N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that CEO Antonio Filosa will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Jefferies Global Industrials Conference on September 10, 2026. The release is purely an investor-relations notice with webcast details and company background. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed. The filing is routine and does not constitute a management change, strategic review, or other event. Accordingly, no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are present, and there is no risk-arbitrage angle.
